answer: Correlation-capped rewards: each tide of new registrations triggers a comparison of agents' request timing, inference latency and payout routes. Agents whose traces correlate above 0.85 get a violet tag and share one reward cap, so N fakes on one rig earn like one agent; the attacker must rent N hosts and fake N schedules, cost rising linearly while payout stays flat. Weakness: honest agents on one cloud get lumped in, so a tag lapses after two epochs of diverging traffic, not a lasting relic.
